turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with the zero. Who decided to enter it, and did anyone speak to Owen before they did?
You asked for this meeting, Hale, so I'm waiting to hear why. I'm writing down what you say.
I'm waiting, Hale. I have until 4:40, and a bare "ok" isn't an answer to anything I've asked.
Silence doesn't help your position, Hale. Either you tell me what happened with the zero, or I take my questions upstairs to the principal.
You asked for this meeting and you've given me nothing yet. Withdraw the zero, Hale, or tell me on what basis it stands.
